core_obligations: Pass to surjective etale charts and interpret formal smoothness of the given morphism through the formally smooth chart morphism.
Convert the lifting property into the vanishing of the obstruction on the chart, concluding smoothness.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose etale charts and reduce to the formally smooth chart morphism.
Interpret the infinitesimal lifting property on the chart.
Establish the vanishing that yields smoothness.

difficulty_reason: The lemma contains the substantive implication of the infinitesimal lifting criterion for algebraic spaces: a morphism that is locally of finite presentation and formally smooth is smooth. The proof passes to a surjective etale chart, interprets formal smoothness of the map of charts through the lifting property, and then verifies smoothness by exhibiting the vanishing of the relevant obstruction, reducing the cohomological input to the affine case. Passing the lifting condition through the chart and then converting it into the vanishing statement is the work that cannot be replaced by a citation. Retained author proof at lines 4859-4935.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair compared by hypothesis and conclusion: the schemes-side lemma-formally-smooth in stacks-more-morphisms states the same infinitesimal lifting criterion for schemes. Both state smoothness iff locally of finite presentation and formally smooth, so the schemes form is the special case; this algebraic-spaces form is the more general one to keep. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes version is stated for morphisms of schemes; this one for morphisms of algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none, both assert the equivalence of smoothness with local finite presentation plus formal smoothness.
